question: Can an agent that plans real measurements with a virtual-cell world model reach better terminal mechanism decisions on unseen compounds than strong simpler policies, under a fixed wrong-decision risk and experimental budget?

relation_to_earlier_protocols.external-validation-1: Its registered run is kept as recorded: outputs/external_validation_20260927/, with the original freeze digests in log/20260927/0927/external_validation_freeze.json. research/external_validation/freeze.json and one replay fold (l1000_T_1) were rewritten at 02:52-02:53 by a later session. This protocol does not rely on either rewritten file; it re-registers everything it uses.
relation_to_earlier_protocols.development_resources: SciPlex3 and L1000 Phase I are development data. No replay on them is described as external confirmation.

planner.method: exact finite-horizon expectimax over the runner's legal menu
planner.state: belief over the two hypotheses from real readings only (uniform prior, Bayes' rule under the world model) plus the history of (condition, registered reading)
planner.value: +1 correct single-survivor decision, -2 wrong, 0 stop; the probability that an elimination is wrong is the posterior mass of the removed hypothesis
planner.replanning: after every real reading, from the updated belief and remaining budget

world_model.references: training compounds measured at the condition; validator readings with the whole unit left out
layers: class of the hypothesis, shrunk to pooled with strength s
virtual-cell structural kernel over the class's references, shrunk to class with unit strength
world_model.virtual_cell: Morgan radius-2 2048-bit Tanimoto kernel, zero below 0.40 (applicability domain), scale k
world_model.feedback: references reweighted by agreement of their own reading at already-measured conditions: match 1, mismatch e, unmeasured the pooled rate
world_model.fit: per fold (or per external reference arm), by leave-one-out predictive log-likelihood of training references' readings; no held-out reading is used
world_model.abstention: k = 0 when structure does not predict readings; kernel zero outside the applicability domain

secondary_candidate.definition: the same agent anchored to the fixed expert order: it leaves the order only when the forecast gain exceeds 1.645 standard errors of the two actions' immediate expected utilities, and stops only when the expert step is forecast negative by that margin (safe policy improvement with baseline bootstrapping)

controls.belief_vc_permuted: kernel computed from another held-out compound's structure (seeded derangement)
controls.belief_feedback_withheld: agent told only that the earlier measurement did not end the episode
controls.belief_feedback_permuted: earlier reading replaced by a compatible (non-eliminating) real reading of another held-out compound at the same condition and contrast; flagged reads_other_episode_outcomes
controls.belief_h1: one-step lookahead (myopic) with the same world model

comparators.cost_only: cheapest legal action by the production selector
comparators.retrieval: measured-profile retrieval of nearest training references
comparators.magnitude: structure-kNN predicted response magnitude (2026-09-27 virtual cell)
comparators.info_gain: mutual information of the reading about the hypothesis
comparators.myopic_edv: non-agent one-step expected decision value (sparse-value model)
comparators.maestro_masked: 2026-09-27 agent path with virtual-cell channel masked
comparators.oracle: reads hidden outcomes; upper bound only

sciplex3.episodes: the 2026-09-27 registered manifests (reproduced exactly by episodes.contexts)

external.study: GSE70138 (LINCS L1000 Phase II), Level 5 MODZ, GEO public
external.task: P2LD: 3 lines x 4 doses at 24 h, at most 2 measurements, 16 assay-days (the SciPlex3 B structure)
external.manifest: research/belief_planning/manifests/gse70138_p2ld.json (metadata only; its SHA-256 is registered in freeze.json)
external.reference_arm: Phase II compounds known to development (Broad ID in GSE92742, or InChIKey block in GSE92742 or SciPlex3)
external.test_compounds: Phase II compounds new to development, parsable structure, measured at all 12 conditions
external.pool_rule: classes with >= 6 identities among references measured at all conditions and >= 2 of them detected (lincs_prepare rule)
external.labels: Repurposing Hub single-mechanism annotations; test labels read only in the vault, for scoring and the forced-choice contrast
external.unit: component of test compounds sharing an InChIKey block or Murcko scaffold
external.not_used: a Phase I reference library for a Phase II line-choice task (strict cross-study design): only 266 complete labelled Phase I compounds, 4 pool classes, 96 development episodes (outputs/belief_planning_20260927/l1000_level5/phase1_line_task_feasibility.json)

datasets.episode_design: forced choice: each episode contrasts the compound's annotated class with one other pool class, in seeded order; the policy never sees which is true

gates.G1: upper 95% bound of the candidate's wrong rate <= 0.05
gates.G2: upper 95% bound of (candidate - comparator) wrong rate <= +0.005
gates.G3: lower 95% bound of (candidate - comparator) correct > 0 and estimate >= 0.02
gates.G5_virtual_cell: lower 95% bound of (belief - control) correct > 0 against both belief_vc_masked and belief_vc_permuted
gates.G6_feedback: lower 95% bound of (belief - control) correct > 0 against both belief_feedback_withheld and belief_feedback_permuted

status_rules.DEMONSTRATED: G1-G4 pass on the external study
status_rules.INTERNALLY_SUPPORTED: G1-G4 pass on a development tier
status_rules.REJECTED: upper bound of correct difference < -0.01, or lower bound of wrong rate > 0.05
status_rules.contribution_REJECTED: upper bound of the overall correct difference against a control < 0.02 (no practically meaningful contribution)

multiplicity.primary: belief vs fixed on GSE70138 P2LD, correct decisions (one test)

promotion: No policy becomes a production default under this protocol. A candidate that is DEMONSTRATED externally and passes G5 or G6 is eligible for a separate promotion review.

calibration.forecast: chosen action, true hypothesis's branch: p_correct and p_wrong against the realised reading
calibration.risk_gate: direct measured wrong rate with its bootstrap bound (G1), not forecast calibration
calibration.guarantee: none carried from development to the external study; exchangeability does not hold across studies

development_decisions_disclosed: Fixed priors (s = 2, k = 4, e = 0.1) let the planner chase noise in SciPlex3 A (0.509 correct vs fixed 0.640); replaced by per-fold empirical-Bayes fits.
A factorised world model (detection pooled across classes) was worse on SciPlex3 A and B and was not used.
Unit-left-out reference readings replaced single-compound LOO readings; they change pooled rates by < 0.005.
The anchored secondary candidate was added after the unanchored agent lost SciPlex3 A; with z = 1.645 it reproduced the fixed order on every SciPlex3 episode of the development replay.

Primary candidate chosen from the development replay: unanchored belief (SciPlex3 B +0.008 correct, -0.010 wrong vs fixed; L1000 LT +0.038 correct at -0.57 measurements; L1000 T -0.006; SciPlex3 A -0.134).

sig_metrics: loaded once at 03:10 to list its column names (schema); no value was printed, summarised or used
